verdict_basis: The six units remain coherent, exact output/write/receipt scopes now close, all 60 planned outputs have exact absent baselines and are currently absent, every top-level validation command has the required execution fields, SWU-MTC-005 has an explicit fail-closed conjunction, the serialized graph is byte-represented consistently, and the Plan recomposes to all five SPEC capabilities. One acceptance-critical blocker remains: the SWU-MTC-005 child-command denominator is not present in any inspected Plan input. The Plan therefore cannot yet prove that the wrapper will execute every required validation surface, the exact currently red full-factory command, or create-output whitespace/symlink/EOF checks. The conjunction is structurally correct but its quantified child set is not exact.
